infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Vault adds calendar events only when you ask it to, and only on this device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vault uses the microphone only when you tap the voice-capture button, to transcribe your note on-device.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Vault creates reminders only when you ask it to, and only on this device.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vault transcribes your voice notes so they can be saved to your private on-device memory.
